appearance: Sunny daytime with dry blue sky and dry ochre grass.
layout: Legacy 2021 Portuguese Grand Prix 4.653km/15-corner layout in a newer-game mod; not a claim of a real2026event. Native station0 is final Galp corner, not start/finish.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Galp exit, pits and long straight
sectors.observed_environment: Long white/gray garage bar and faceted blade-like main-grandstand roof; broad green margins and steep descending/cresting straight. The round TorreVIP is mapped across the infield, not a second invented pit tower.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Opening corners and Lagos
sectors.observed_environment: Broad descending turns with pale gravel escape and green aprons; low covered stand and dry grassy banks. Roofs visible across lower terrain, not dense forest.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Torre VIP uphill hairpin
sectors.observed_environment: Strong elevation break into slow corner, concentric grass banks, sparse olive-like trees and small seating sections. Red/white kerbs, local raised orange apex element. Distinct rounded/stacked-disc glazed TorreVIP building at mapped footprint157736297 on left of adjacent parallel road; do not duplicate it beside the pit straight.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Samsung middle corners
sectors.observed_environment: Rolling road over blind crests, pale gravel on outside, wide green paved margins where visible and patchy dry grass. Keep low scrub and long hillside sightlines.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Craig Jones and Portimão
sectors.observed_environment: Blind uphill and descending linked turns among open grassy hills, scattered broadleaf/olive-like trees and limited temporary stands. Raised orange/white-red apex elements are local, not continuous.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Sagres to Galp return
sectors.observed_environment: Long sweeping final curve follows rolling terrain toward pit complex. Red/white kerbs, green apron, pale gravel and dry cut banks; main-roof blades and circular VIP tower reappear.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

terrain.shortcomings: GLO-90 cannot resolve blind crests/valleys. DGT2026mainland LiDAR release advertises0.5m/2mDTM with90percent coverage at release; verify exact Algarve tiles/epoch/licence before use. Native0 wraps final corner so S/F-relative station recipes will misplace all structures.
terrain.data_status: Candidate metadata reviewed; no candidate raster downloaded or claimed as incorporated.

authoring_constraints: Use mapped building footprints and match rooflines, structural supports, facade depth and stepped volumes; names alone do not establish likeness.
Place grass/gravel/asphalt runoff per registered corner, with protection at outside edge; do not fill escape areas with independent tiles/blocks.
Road, kerbs, shoulder and protection share smooth station sampling; kerbs only in explicit ranges.
Maintain venue-specific vegetation around complete route, preserving long sightlines/open water where present.
Reference pixels remain ignored; generate geometry and materials only.
quality_gates: Matching cockpit frame at each sector and every braking/turn sequence.
Oblique view of runoff shapes, architectural footprints and terrain.
Full lap motion review for edge smoothness, floating objects, protection gaps and missing surroundings.
Luna high reviewer must evaluate rendered evidence, not this recipe.
